job.question: In the American Academy of Actuaries' 2011 RFP for retirement plan and related consulting services, what were the plan assets at 12/31/10 of each of its three retirement plans?
job.expected_facts: Money Purchase plan: $3,015,682; 401(k) plan: $1,993,513; Defined Benefit plan: $647,181 (all as of 12/31/10).
job.acceptance: Accept amounts mapped correctly to Money Purchase, 401(k), and Defined Benefit; profit-sharing description is optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2024 global custody RFP for the Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System, not the American Academy of Actuaries’ 2011 consulting-services RFP. It does not provide the three requested plan asset amounts as of 12/31/10.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System (“SBCERS”) Issue Date: January 8, 2024
As of September 30, 2023, SBCERS had approx. $4.06 billion in assets.
